title: Nonzero map from rank-one derived module
statement: theorem derivedModule_rankOne_nonzero_map {S : Type w} [Ring S] [HasDerivedCategory.{max w vH} (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)] [HasCoproducts.{max w vH} (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S))] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)) (hK : ¬ IsZero K) : ∃ n : ℤ, ∃ f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of S (ULift.{vH} S)) ⟶ K⟦n⟧, f ≠ 0

proof.text: First use the derived-category homology criterion to choose an integer n and a nonzero class x in Hⁿ(K). Apply the chain-level cycle-to-derived-map lemma to x, obtaining the required nonzero map from the lifted rank-one single complex.
